predecessors.name: Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Gaul as the Roman Empire held it in 392: Eugenius was 'elevated to augustus on 22 August 392 at Lyons'

successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: Gaul and Italy, the West that Eugenius and Arbogast held after they marched 'into Italy in the spring of 393'

ledger.x: 22 August 392: Arbogast raises Eugenius to Augustus of the West at Lyons.
spring 393: Eugenius and Arbogast march into Italy.
5 September 394: Theodosius reaches the Julian Alps.
6 September 394: the usurpation ends and Theodosius holds the whole empire.

wars.name: Battle of the Frigidus
wars.outcome: Theodosian victory: the usurper Eugenius was beheaded and the general Arbogast committed suicide on 6-7 September 394; Theodosius gained the Western Empire.

certainty.note: The pages name Lyons, Italy and the Julian Alps only; no province list is given for Eugenius's regime.
